name: instruction
label: Instructions text
default: Not all financial topics should be approached the same way. Classifying topics can help facilitators choose the best way to present them. Drag and drop or click/tap to select each of the topics below and sort them into their category columns.

fields.name: simple
fields.label: Simple Category Tips
fields.default: Filler Tip: To make simple topics engaging, use quick-fire quizzes, interactive matching games, and real-life scenario simulations to keep learners active.

fields.name: dry
fields.label: Dry Category Tips
fields.default: Filler Tip: Dry topics (like terms of service or regulation details) can be made engaging by using storytelling, gamification elements, or group problem-solving exercises.

fields.name: complex
fields.label: Complex Category Tips
fields.default: Filler Tip: For complex topics, break them into clear modular micro-lessons, use visual flowcharts, step-by-step progress trackers, and detailed case studies.

fields.name: hot
fields.label: Hot-button Category Tips
fields.default: Filler Tip: Engage learners on hot-button topics by facilitating anonymous voting, structuring debates, using roleplay, and offering space for reflection.

fields.name: id
fields.label: Unique ID
fields.description: Unique identifier, e.g. atm, checking, budget
